content: Aylleta Ayso Woga
«Neni Isra7eele naytas immana wogay hayssa.
Neni Isra7eele nayta garsafe aylle shammiko izi nees usuppun layth ooththo; gido attiin laappunththa layththan izi aykkoka qanxxontta aylleteththafe coo mela yedetto.
Izi barkka yidaa gidikko barkka bo; ba machcheyra yidaa gidikko iza machcheyakka izara bu.
Iza goday izas machcho ekkidaa gidikko machcheya izas adde nayta woykko macca nayta yelidaa gidikko, he maccassayanne izi nayti iza godaas attiko izi barkka kezi bo.
Gido attiin he aylley, ‹Tani ta godaa, ta machchiyonne ta nayta siiqays; tani aylleteththafe kezikke› giikko,
iza goday iza pirdiza asa sinth aaththo; hessafe guye keeththa penge woykko penge qosilaththaako iza efidi iza hayth goonththan lukko. Histtiko izi ba de7o layth ubbaan izas aylle gidana.
«Asi ba macca nayo aylleteththas bayzikko adde aylleti aylleteththafe keziza mala iza kezuppu.
Iza bana dooridi efida godaa ufayssontta ixxiko izi goday izo wozzisanaas koshshees. Izi izis ammanettontta aggida gishshas izo allagas bayzana bessenna.
Izi izo ba naas ekkanaas koykko ba macca naas ooththiza mala izis bessizayssa ooththo.
Izi baas hara machcho ekkiko koyro machcheys quma woykko may7o pacisoppo; qasse izira aqo aggofo.
Izi hayta heedzdzata izis immontta ixxiko aykko miishsheyka qanxxettontta aylleteththafe kezada bu.
Iita Ooththida Asati Qaxxayettiza Woga
«As wodhida asi hayqqanaas bessees.
Xoossa shene gidi uttiin qoppontta dishe as wodhidaadey tani giigsidaso bete bo.
Gido attiin as wodhana qoppidi erishe hara as wodhikko hessaadey attanaas giidi he ta giigsida taas yarsho shiishshizaso yiikko yarshizasohozappe haraso efada wodha.
«Ba aawa woykko ba aayo wadhdhiza asi oonikka hayqqo.
«Asa wolqqan oykkidi bayzizaadey woykko wolqqan oykkiin asi iza kushen beettidaadey hayqqanaas bessees.
«Ba aawa woykko ba aayo cayizaadey hayqqo.
«Nam7u asati ba garsan ooyettiko, issoy issaa shuchchara caddiko woykko kushera icciko he qohettidaadezi hayqqontta hargidi hiixan ichchiko,
hessafe dendidi guufera kare giddon hemettiko, he qohidayssi qaxxayettontta attees; gidikkoka izi iza ooso teqqida gishshas miishshe qanxxanaassinne izi paxana gakkanaas iza xeellanaas koshshees.
«Asi ba attuma aylle woykko macca aylleyo guufen shocikko he shochchaa geedon heerakka iza kushen hayqqiko shocidayssi qaxxayettanaas bessees.
Gido attiin he qohettidayssi issi gallas woykko nam7u gallas gakkanaas hayqqontta aggiko he ayllezi iza miish gidida gishshas izi qaxxayettenna.

«Nam7u asati ba garsan issoy issaara ooyettishe qanththara diza maccassayo boshas gaththiko, hessafe hara iita miish izi bolla gaththontta aggiko, izi bolla qoho gaththidaadey he maccassay azinay oychchidayssa daannati pirdiko ay miishsheka qanxxo.
Gido attiin izis boshay darikko shemppo gishshas shemppo,
ayfe gishshas ayfe, achcha gishshas achcha, kushe gishshas kushe, toho gishshas toho,
xuussa gishshas xuus, madunththa gishshas madunth, qoo7o gishshas qoo7o ekkanaas bessees.
«Issi asi attuma woykko macca aylle ayfe shoci toyssiko he ayfeza gishshas aylleteththafe kessi yeddo.
Hessaththoka ba aylley woykko ba aylleza ach menththiko he achchaa gishshas aylleteththafe kessi yeddo.
«Booray maccas woykko attumas icci wodhikko, he booray shuchchan cadetti hayqqo; iza ashoy meetettofo. Gido attiin boora goday qaxxayettofo.

Gido attiin booray kasekka icciza boora gidikko, asay booraza godaas yootidishin booraa goday booraa qachchontta aggiko, booray adde woykko macca as wodhikko he booray shuchchan cadetti hayqqo; qasse booraza godaykka hayqqo.
Gido attiin izi cigo qanxxana mala oyshettiko istti oychchidayssa ay gidikkoka qanxxidi ba shemppo wozzo.
Booray attuma naa woykko macca naa icci wodhikko pirday issi mala gido.
Booray attuma aylle woykko macca aylleyo icci wodhikko booraa goday aylleza godaas heedzdzu tammu bira ciggo; booraykka shuchchan cadettidi hayqqo.
«Issi asi olla kama qaarikko woykko olla bookkidi kammontta aggiko, booray woykko harey he ollaan wulliko,
he ollaza goday meheza waaga qanxxo. Izi meheza godaas waaga qanxxidi hayqeththaa baas ekko.
«Issi asa booray hara asa boora icci wodhikko, icci wodhida paxa booraa bayzidi iza miishshanne hayqqida booraza ashoza giddon gina shaakki ekketto.
Gido attiin he booray icciza boora gididayssi kaseti erettishin, iza goday iza qachchontta aggiko, iza goday booraa gishshas boora qanxxidi he hayqqidayssa baas ekko.
